name: @denta/client-app
description: Denta Client mobile app (Expo). Runs the shared mobile codebase with APP_VARIANT=client.

scripts.start: cd ../.. && cross-env APP_VARIANT=client EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=client npx expo start --port 8081
scripts.android: cd ../.. && cross-env APP_VARIANT=client EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=client npx expo start --android --port 8081
scripts.ios: cd ../.. && cross-env APP_VARIANT=client EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=client npx expo start --ios --port 8081
